description: JVIZ Talking Points is a versatile Power BI visual that allows you to create data-driven narratives that speak to your data stories. Create unique talking points with multi-column layouts to similar to news articles or magazine layouts or configure a traditional single column slide deck layout. Dashboard designs are enhanced when you mix and match multiple JVIZ Talking Point visuals on a single page to create a mosaic of textual content that compliments your charts and graphs. Key Features include: ● 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗛𝗶𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵𝘆: Add several layers of talking points. ● 𝗠𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶-𝗖𝗼𝗹𝘂𝗺𝗻: Organize text into multiple columns. ● 𝗠𝗶𝘅 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗠𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵: Add multiple visuals to create unique talking point layouts. ● 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗻: Generate dynamic slide decks and visuals. ● 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺 𝗦𝘁𝘆𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴: Easily change the color, spacing, and branding for sections and text. ● 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻: The visual automatically adjusts the text layout.
